verdict.rationale: IRCC runs its own public processing-times checker. Users select their application type to see how long processing will take, and IRCC publishes the method behind the figures (the time taken to process 80% of that application type in the past). Missing for 10: evidence that the Start-up Visa or founder-specific application types are listed in the checker, independent or hands-on corroboration, and times that reflect current conditions rather than past processing only.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself

citations.quote: Select your application type to get an idea of how long it’ll take us to process your application.
We calculate them by checking how long it took us to process 80% of that type of application in the past
